text:
With centuries of stupor,

with centuries of hatred and tears,

with a multitude of loving, blind men,

destined for death,

drowning in my own blood, here, facedown.

Like a wounded dog surrounded by people.

Ugly as the newborn

and sad as the corpse of the woman who gave birth.


Those of us who are truly cold,

who are alone everywhere,

who have nobody,

who cannot let themselves be destroyed,

those people don't matter, are worth nothing, nothing,

let them clear out once and for all, let them die soon.

Let's see if it's true: die.

Die, Jaime, die!


Ah, you mule of a life,

stubborn, deaf!

translation.title: That's How It Is
